criteria.description: Representative static and dynamic Bahia web routes render in Chromium without uncaught page errors.
Representative static and dynamic Bahia web routes render in Chromium without unexpected console errors, including bootstrap-discovery failures.
The DNS route test provides deterministic NIP-11 metadata for the configured test relay, preventing external DNS/network failures from appearing as route console errors.
Regression coverage uses Nostr event-stream harness semantics: scoped REQ delivery receives EVENTs and EOSE rather than timeout-based completion assertions.
